controls.knowledge_source: declared service call graph released with PetShop (methods c, d only)

metric_defs.AC@k: tie-aware expected hit of the single true root-cause node in the top k
metric_defs.AC@k_strict: AC@k with abstentions counted as misses

abstention_rule: abstain iff no candidate, or >= 4 candidates and relative margin between 3rd and 4th score <= tau; tau tuned on train only (ab12_prereg.json)

files.rca_probe.json: all results, per-issue ranks, P15 verdict

regime_detail: D+K for declared topology (c, d); D otherwise (a, a2, b, b_rand, e, b+abstain); per-method regime is in rca_probe.json results.*.*.regime
